thesis: The scoring engine says “Apply and hold for the long term” for holding (92/100) and “Not enough data to judge yet” for listing day, from 48% of the data it needs.
Strongest point: price next to similar companies. Biggest worry: reliance on top customers.
Next to similar companies a share looks worth about ₹304.45, against the ₹172 asking price.

sentences: 3 similar listed companies trade at 19x to 27.7x their yearly profit (middle: 27.7x), at today's market prices.
Applied to its earnings per share of ₹2.75 in Q1FY27 (₹11 for a full year), a share would be worth ₹209.37 (low), ₹304.45 (middle) or ₹304.93 (high).
Against the top of the price band, ₹172, the middle value means 77% upside.
Q1FY27 covers only part of a year; scaling it up assumes the rest of the year goes the same way.
Cross-check: at the peers' middle EV/EBITDA of 9.94x, after taking off net debt, a share would be worth ₹134.77 against ₹304.45 from P/E: the two differ by more than 20%, so treat both with care.
This is a rough guide, not a forecast: it assumes the company deserves the same price tag as its listed peers.
